name: Hazuki Maho
source:
An underclassman in the lacrosse team. Maho is a cute and energetic girl that happens to be Shimomura Isao's girlfriend. She thinks of [url=/c3275]Kida[/url] as an older brother, and tends to feel more at ease around him than around her boyfriend.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_When_There_Is_No_Angel]Wikipedia[/url]]
